name: Margaret “Peggy” Quinn (McKeldin)
notable_stories: Known as Granny to her grandchildren
She was the daughter of the man who raised Barbara and Chuck as orphans
Eventually married their father, Buckey, becoming Barbara's stepmother and a pillar of the family
Peggy was in nursing school when Barbara and Chuck moved in after Ethel's 1952 death
Peggy's 2008 Baltimore Sun obituary is the source that unlocked the entire McKeldin branch
Funeral at St. Dominic Catholic Church; interred at New Cathedral Cemetery
Peggy and Emily Schriefer were 1st cousins: John Joseph Quinn (Peggy's father) was Ethel Quinn Schriefer's youngest brother
Peggy was in nursing school when Barbara and Chuck moved in with her family (~1952) after Ethel's death
Barbara lived at grandmother's house until she was 5 or 6
Peggy's 2008 Baltimore Sun obituary named children Charles E Jr., Barbara J Adams, J. Michael McKeldin — the source that unlocked the entire branch
A family photo shows her as a May Queen. She stayed home with her son Mike when the family had only one car.
Peggy went with Barbara and John on the 1993 Alaska cruise and on a family trip to Hawaii (Oahu, Maui and the Big Island).
Every Christmas she set out her silver candy dishes filled with ribbon hard candy; with Buckey she filled in Barbara's twelve place settings of china, crystal and silver after the wedding.
milestones: Married Charles E. Buckey McKeldin II
Married Charles E Buckey McKeldin II
Funeral at St. Dominic Catholic Church; interred at New Cathedral Cemetery
Religion: She was Roman Catholic. Because Buckey was not yet Catholic, their wedding took place outside the altar area.
career: Worked as a nurse after nursing school.
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: Siblings listed: Joan, John, and Pat. Daughter of John Joseph Quinn.
Brendan's Granny. Daughter of John Joseph Quinn and Marie Ellinghaus-Quinn.
Brendan's 'Granny.' Emily Schriefer (first wife of Buckey) was Peggy's 1st cousin.
